intervention_execution.claim: R95 frozen insertion and R96 joint training executed; cross-fold not executed.

intended_intermediate.claim: The same utility constructs and reads its routing; self-score response is nonnegative while CE direction is mixed. Cross-fold algebra changes self-coupling to a cross-fold bilinear response.

observable_output.claim: R95 Macro worsened; R96 full-minus-native development Macro/CE positive, full Macro slightly below simplex.

task_utility.claim: R96 development positive versus native but not simplex Macro; no cross-fold task utility or independent confirmation.

trace_adequacy.selection_rule: All original predeclared development examples in reports; no selected case attribution.
trace_adequacy.target_boundary: Labels never enter the proposed forward path; fit labels only in supervised loss, evaluation labels metrics only.

primary_explanation.statement: Utility reuse can favor self-response without improving multiclass discrimination; recipient noise self-selection is a hypothesis, not an observed cause.

alternative_explanations.statement: Shared contextual errors violate conditional noise independence; cross-fold may retain biased noise coupling.
Fold separation discards useful between-fold routing information or weakens signals; partitioning and compute, rather than donor separation, explain differences.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Cross-fold donor dependence versus self-fold dependence, including correlated-noise failure and lost signal.
discriminating_measurement.measurement: Native parity, recipient-utility intervention, cross/self local responses and independent/positive-correlated/negative-correlated bounded synthetic noise at fixed states; later jointly fit native/full/self_fold/cross_fold.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: Cross donor dependency and signed local geometry match exact predictions; independent synthetic noise averages zero while correlated noise can fail.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: Implementation violates parity/gradients; or realistic errors are not identified, leaving the noise interpretation unresolved regardless of math checks.

forbidden_rescue_variants: No optional eta/epsilon/seed/epoch rescue of the frozen postfit contract.

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Jointly train the existing utility-to-measurement path with shared states/value/decoder tensors.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: One-init development evidence only; class-centering changes the function and inherits no utility tier.

selected_candidate.title: Cross-fold utility construction and recipient readout
selected_candidate.causal_difference: Valid-order alternating folds: one fold constructs the other fold routing; native fold masses and all token utilities retained in readout.
selected_candidate.discriminating_measurement: Donor fold effects/covariances/scales, native fold masses, alpha, raw utilities and logits; cross versus self-fold Jacobian and noise witnesses.
selected_candidate.success_gate: One reviewed managed synthetic canary must pass eight fixed source/mask/gradient/locality/noise checks; no task-utility promotion from synthetic pass.
selected_candidate.kill_condition: Any source mapping, nonfinite gradient or native parity failure blocks execution qualification. Correlated-noise witnesses limit the interpretation. Short later task screen null is inconclusive without rescue.
selected_candidate.authorization_boundary: Owner sustained bounded research; shared scheduler only; full formal runs collaborator-only; no new capacity.

limitations: No measured cross-fold task utility or identified NLP error model.
Conditional error assumptions are unverified; contextual folds need not be independent.
No novelty clearance or formal execution authority; synthetic qualification is not CaseStudy readiness.
